description_html:
Wacom Cintiq pro 16 


Accuracy redefined in a compact design

When creativity strikes, you want to bring your vision to life effortlessly. That’s why we’ve refined Wacom Cintiq Pro 16 to make it even more comfortable and natural to work on. With enhanced ergonomics and an intuitive pen-on-screen experience, you can fully immerse yourself in your craft.


Live. Dare. Create.

Improved by you

After listening to feedback from our customers, we’ve enhanced Wacom Cintiq Pro 16 to help boost your creative output.


ExpressKeys™

Time-saving ExpressKeys™

Our new physical ExpressKeys™ are now positioned at the rear edge of the display, so there’s no compromise on screen size when you’re getting to work on your canvas. Designed for more efficient working, the ExpressKeys™ help to give you the time you need to add that extra level of polish to every project.


Controls

No unintended touches

To avoid a stray button tap interrupting your workflow, we’ve refined the display to give you greater control. A new button ensures the touch function only switches on/off when you need it. Plus, Enhanced On-Screen Controls gives you even more control of your touch functionality.


Connectivity

Connect and play

Linking Wacom Cintiq Pro 16 to your Mac or Windows PC is effortless.
PC: Windows® 7 or later (Latest service pack/ build)

Mac: macOS 10.14 or later (Latest update)
All you need to do is connect the USB-C* and HDMI cables – whether at your desk or on your lap. And you can rest easy knowing that all the cables are designed sustainably, containing absolutely PVC-free**

* Requires a USB-C port with DisplayPort Alternate Mode. Alternatively Cintiq Pro 16 can be connected to a HDMI and a USB-A port.


The magic inside our technology

Our goal at Wacom has always been to bring people and technology together with natural, intuitive devices that help you make the most of your creativity.


Created for all who want to express ideas, we work with our customers to constantly improve our products in line with their needs. Robust yet refined, advanced yet intuitive, we are proud to provide benchmark creative technology for today and tomorrow.


Find out how our technology works.

Wacom Pen


Press Sense

Wacom Pro Pen is sensitive to the way you write and draw and recognizes thick lines, thin lines, and shading.


Tilt Tracker

We’ve created tech that captures your specially angled strokes for comfortable and accurate shading.


Custom Nibs

Wacom’s range of nibs provide the right feel and durability for different kinds of work and creativity – so you can choose the tip that suits your needs the best.


Natural Touch

Writing with a Wacom pen is totally intuitive – like using a traditional pen. And thanks to our cutting-edge technology, it’s intelligent enough to know what the natural weight of your hand feels like for drawing fast and slow, and for shading or any other textural effect.


Battery-Free Pen

Wacom pens are battery-free and lightweight, thanks to Wacom-patented EMR technology. That means they’re comfortable to use over long periods of time.


Wacom Screen

True Point

Pixel-precise alignment between pen tip and drawing point gives the sensation of drawing on paper.


Textured Glass

We’ve coated our glass screens with a special treatment to add friction, which means drawing on your Wacom device feels like drawing on paper.


True Picture

Our industry-leading color displays showcase uniform brightness, high resolution, and true-to-life color quality, making them ideal for every role, from animation to design.


Pixel Perfect

We’ve carefully engineered our screens to avoid parallax  – the disconnect between where you expect the cursor to be, and where it actually is – so working with Wacom screens is intuitive and comfortable.


Glare-Free

We’ve treated all our screens with a special reflection-reducing coating to make sure they’re gentle on the eyes and comfortable to work with over long hours.


Wacom Performance

Anti-jitter technology means your lines are clear and smooth.


Anti-Lag

There’s virtually no lag between you moving the pen and what shows up on screen – so it feels like you’re drawing or writing with pen and paper.



"Especially for sculpting and texturing, the stroke needs to sit perfectly on the mesh. With the Cintiq Pro 16, I can place my strokes pixel perfect. The haptic feedback of the new ExpressKeys keeps me focused on my work. No pause when I have to search something on my keyboard."


VBring a natural precision to every pixel

Our anti-glare 4K screen and Pro Pen 2 work in harmony to create a completely natural pen-on-screen experience. Every stroke you make on the screen’s etched glass surface gives you that realistic sensation of pen on paper, while the wide color gamut lets you see your art in perfect detail.


And with built in pressure sensitivity, virtually lag-free tracking and superior tilt capabilities, Wacom Pro Pen 2 not only looks like a pen, it feels like one too.


Great bundled creative apps

Get complimentary software offers with every Cintiq Pro


1-Toon Boom Harmony ( 3 months free )

2-Toon Boom Storyboard Pro ( 3 months free )

3- MASV ( 3 free months) (or 250 GB) )

4-Shapr3D ( 3 months free )

5-Bluescape ( 3 months free )


*To get your 90-day complimentary software you need to sign in with your Wacom ID, respectively create a Wacom ID account with your personal data, and register your device. To begin using the software after installation, registration with Toon Boom is required.

description_html_ar:
ارسم بسلاسة 

شاشة واكوم Cintiq Pro 16 تعطيك إحساس الرسم على الورق بإضافة احساس الإحتكاك، مع  جودة ودقة عالية مما يجعلها مثالية لكل شئ، بدءًا من الرسوم المتحركة ووصولاً إلى التصميم.

تتميز الشاشة بدقة الـ 4K وبمساحتها التي تبلُغ 15.6 بوصة، مزودة بـ 8 مفاتيح اختصار يُمكنك تخصيصهم وفقاً لسير عملك، وتوفيراً لوقتك بدلاً من الإنتقال بين الإعدادات، وتوفيراً لمساحة الشاشة واستغلالها كاملةً وضعت مفاتيح الاختصار على الحافة الخلفية للشاشة.


تعمل باللمس ويُمكنك تجنب اللمسات الغير مقصودة من خلال زر إيقاف/تشغيل التاتش كما تمنحُك عناصر التحكم السلسلة التي تظهر على الشاشة تحكماً أكثر في وظائف اللمس لديك. 


AG glass

استمتع بالرسم على شاشة غير متوهجة مُعالجة بطبقة خاصة تقلل من الانعكاس للتأكد من أنها لطيفة على العينين ومريحة عند العمل عليها لساعات طويلة.


كما أنه لا يوجد أي تأخير بين تحريك القلم وما يظهر على الشاشة، كما أن القلم ثابت بشكل مثالي.


اكتشف الفن مع قلم فائق الاستجابة 

ارسم بدون انقطاع مع قلم واكوم لا يحتاج إلى شحن أو بطارية وذلك بفضل تقنية EMR الحاصلة على براءة اختراع من Wacom.


يدعم القلم 8192 مستوى من مستويات حساسية الضغط، مع 60 درجة من حساسية الإمالة.


اتصال سهل 

يُمكنك توصيل الشاشة بأجهزة : Windows 7 أو أحدث
macOS 10.14 أو أحدث 

من خلال توصيل كابلات USB-C  أو HDMI


* يتطلب منفذ USB-C وضع DisplayPort البديل. أو يمكن توصيل Cintiq Pro 16 بمنفذ HDMI ومنفذ USB-A.


تطبيقات إبداعية مجمعة رائعة

احصل على عروض البرامج المجانية مع كل جهاز Cintiq Pro


1-Toom Boon harmony ( ثلاث أشهر مجاناً)

2-Toon Boom Storyboard Pro (ثلاث أشهر مجاناً)

3- MASV (ثلاث أشهر مجانية) (أو 250 جيجابايت)

4-Shapr3D (ثلاث أشهر مجانية )

5-Bluescape (ثلاث أشهر مجانية)


*للحصول على البرنامج المجاني لمدة 90 يومًا، يتعين عليك تسجيل الدخول باستخدام معرف Wacom الخاص بك، وإنشاء حساب Wacom ID ببياناتك الشخصية، ثم تسجيل جهازك. لبدء استخدام البرنامج بعد التثبيت، يلزم التسجيل في Toon Boom.


المحتويات 


واكوم سينتيك برو 16

قلم واكوم برو 2

حامل أقلام مزود بـ 10 سنون بديلة (6 قياسية و4 غير ناعمة) وأداة إزالة السن

حامل قلم مع 3 سنون بديلة (3 قياسية)

 X 13 سنون 

كابل USB-C إلى USB-C 

كابل USB-C إلى USB-A

كابل Premium HDMI  

سلك الطاقة 

AC adaptor
